verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe fetched a publicly downloadable OpenAPI document at docs.agentmail.to/openapi.json (HTTP 200, containing the "openapi" key). This directly delivers a machine-readable API spec. The docs also include an API reference page. Missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec download, and evidence of the spec's completeness or that it is kept in sync with the API.
